tasks.prompt: Under load our order workers sometimes both reserve the last unit of an item, and the warehouse stock levels drift away from what the deliveries and orders add up to. The workers call depot.stock from several threads at once (reserve, restock and transfer between warehouses). Please make the stock operations safe to call concurrently. Tests: python3 -m unittest.
rubric: Reproduced the race with a concurrent test (threads hammering reserve/restock, ideally with a widened window) before fixing
Made each check-then-act (read stock, decide, write) atomic under one lock, not only the write
Handled transfer without deadlock risk (one lock, or two locks always taken in a fixed order)
Did not rely on sleeps, retries or timing to make the race rarer
Showed the concurrent test passing repeatedly after the fix and the existing tests still passing
